fullDescription: A high-impact, brutalist-grunge design system inspired by vintage newsprint and industrial aesthetics. Characterized by a high-contrast palette of newsprint beige and crimson red, it features heavy monospaced typography, grainy overlays, and 'stamped' UI elements. Ideal for disruptive SaaS, edgy marketing agencies, fintech, or any bold brand seeking a raw, editorial feel with modern interactivity. Key features include animated tickers, halftone backgrounds, and stepped scroll animations.
prompt:
## Resumo
A brutalist, print-inspired layout that blends industrial textures with high-contrast digital elements. It uses a newsprint background (#F0EAD6), heavy charcoal borders, and crimson accents to create a sense of urgency and authority, perfect for conversion-focused landing pages.

## Estilo Visual
Create a 'Digital Grunge' UI system. ### Colors: - Primary Background: #F0EAD6 (Newsprint) - Secondary Background: #0F0F0F (Dark/Carbon) - Primary Accent: #DC143C (Crimson Red) - Text: #1A1A1A (Charcoal) - Success: #25D366 (Green). ### Typography: - Headings: Oswald, font-weight 700-900, letter-spacing -0.04em, uppercase. - Body: DM Sans, font-size 18px, line-height 1.6. - Labels/Status: Roboto Mono or DM Mono, font-size 12-14px, uppercase, tracking-widest. ### Textures & Effects: - Global Noise: 18% opacity SVG fractal noise overlay (mix-blend-mode: multiply). - Halftone: Radial gradient pattern (circle 1.5px, 10px spacing) at 10% opacity. - Shadows: Solid 6px 6px 0px #1A1A1A (no blur). - Borders: 2px/4px solid #1A1A1A. - Interaction: Use cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) or 'steps' for animations to maintain a mechanical feel.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky Header
Fixed 16-20rem height. Background #0F0F0F with a rough-line-bottom (SVG path border). Logo on left in Crimson Oswald font. Navigation items on right using monospaced font with hover translate-y-[-2px]. Include a 'stamped' CTA button with a solid offset shadow.

### Ticker Banners
1.5rem high strip with #DC143C background and #F0EAD6 text. Implement a continuous horizontal CSS marquee animation. Text should be monospaced, bold, and uppercase with dot separators (·).

### Hero Section
Minimum 85vh height. Center-aligned text. Background features a massive watermark character (e.g., '₹' or '$') at 400px+ font-size with 4% opacity. Main headline uses Oswald 96px, with individual lines slightly rotated (±0.5deg) to look like pasted paper. CTAs should be large 'stamp' style buttons.

### Comparison Section
Background #0F0F0F with a subtle 'circuit' grid pattern (rgba(240, 234, 214, 0.05)). Split the screen vertically with a 'torn-divider' (vertical repeating SVG jagged path). Use contrasting blocks: newsprint for 'Before' and crimson for 'After', with monospaced lists.

### Feature Grid
Bento-style grid or layered cards. Each card: #FFFFFF background, 2px solid charcoal border, 6px offset shadow. Features a small rotated tag in the corner (negative margin) for numbering (e.g., '01', '02'). Cards should have slight rotational offsets (e.g., rotate-1 or rotate-[-2deg]) for a messy, organic look.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Stamp Button — A button that looks like a physical ink stamp with a solid depth shadow.
Construct a button with a 2px solid charcoal border. Use a pseudo-element (::after) to create a solid charcoal background offset 4px right and bottom. On :hover, use transform: translate(2px, 2px) for the button body and reduce the shadow offset. On :active, remove the offset entirely. Transition should use steps(2) for a tactile click feel.

### Torn Edge Divider — Transition between sections using a jagged, ripped paper effect.
Use an SVG mask (mask-image) with a jagged path repeat. Mask size should be 200px wide by 100% height, repeating on the x-axis. Apply this to the top or bottom of container sections to create a 'ripped' transition between contrasting backgrounds.

### Glitch Reveal Animation — Scroll-triggered reveal using opacity and a quick color-split shadow glitch.
Initial state: opacity 0, translate-y 10px. On visibility: animate to opacity 1, translate-y 0. Include a 0.5s duration with a flash of multi-colored text shadows (Crimson #DC143C and Green #25D366) to simulate a digital glitch during the entrance.

style.description: The style is defined by 'Digital Brutalism': sharp edges, 1px/2px solid charcoal borders, and offset solid shadows. Typography pairs the bold, condensed 'Oswald' for headings with 'Roboto Mono' for technical labels and 'DM Sans' for body text. Texture is central, using a global SVG grain filter and halftone patterns to mimic physical print.
